product_metadata.title: EpicGadget Large Star Solar Light, Solar Star Wind Chime Color Changing Waterproof Outdoor Solar Garden Decorative Lights for Walkway Pathway Backyard Christmas Decoration Parties (Large Star)
features: The large star garden solar lights LEDs powered by solar panel can be used as decoration to give a colorful mood to your garden parties.
The solar star light automatically change colors slowly, gives you colorful light show at night. (It does not stay on one color, it always change)
Build with automatic light sensor function, the solar lights auto on at night & off by day.
600Mah 1.2V AA Ni-MH rechargeable battery for up to 8 hours of illumination on a full charge.
Package Includes: 1 x Clear Large Star Solar LED Lights
